verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a dedicated Financial Connections testing mode: the auth flow shows only Stripe-managed test institutions, and accounts can be linked without real credentials, so testing never touches real bank data. A community user also reports being sent to the test dashboard, which independently confirms a separate test environment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of test/live key isolation and data separation, detail on available test scenarios (balances, transactions, ownership, failure cases), and agent-specific guidance for driving the sandbox programmatically.
